CustomField.description: DEV #4. Number of Subscriptions active today on this Contract. Calculated by SubscriptionTrigger (when a Subscription is created, edited, deleted or restored) and ActiveSubscriptionRecountBatch (every night at 2:00). Amendment revisions do not add up: it counts one per original Subscription with a net quantity greater than 0.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Subscriptions in force today (already started, not ended and not terminated). Amendments change the quantity of a Subscription, they do not add new Subscriptions. Updated automatically.
CustomField.label: Active Subscriptions
